Build an instrumented binary of origin/main (rust 1.99.1: put /Users/gabe/.rustup/toolchains/1.99.1-aarch64-apple-darwin/bin first on PATH; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/gabe/Projects/caliper-fixtures/shrink/target-reach; use cargo-llvm-cov if installed, else RUSTFLAGS=-C instrument-coverage with llvm-profdata/llvm-cov from the toolchain; if neither works, report that and stop).

3.
